verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a GraphQL Developer API with introspection and a browser-based playground that works "without installing any client libraries," plus agent skills in the compliance-skills repo. None of these is an official SDK or client library, and no SDK package is documented anywhere in the pack. A raw API is a developer building block, not the SDK capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
